clusters.title: Thanksgiving Travel Disruptions and Holiday News
clusters.summary: Severe weather and accidents, including a FedEx cargo plane running off a runway in Miami, have caused widespread flight cancellations and travel disruptions across the US during the Thanksgiving holiday. Meanwhile, families and communities celebrate with parades, traditional dinners, and sports events.

clusters.title: Markets, Economy, and Trade Policies
clusters.summary: Stock markets and Nasdaq futures climbed as the AI trade rebounded, even as institutions like the Bank of England warned of growing financial risks from AI borrowing. Additionally, international trade partners are responding strongly to new tariff plans and economic adjustments proposed by Donald Trump.

clusters.title: Gaming Industry Buzz and GTA VI Launches
clusters.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI has driven massive headlines by recording the UK's biggest physical launch since 2019 and pushing PlayStation 5 hardware to its limits. Other gaming news covers studio union votes, upcoming platform releases, and Black Friday tech and console discounts.

clusters.title: Scientific Discoveries and Space Exploration
clusters.summary: Researchers continue to make fascinating breakthroughs, ranging from human mini-brains grown for 40 days in space to the discovery of the world's largest known scorpion. NASA and other space agencies are actively investigating technical challenges and preparing for future lunar and deep-space missions.

clusters.title: NFL and Thanksgiving Sports Action
clusters.summary: The Thanksgiving NFL slate delivered high-stakes action, highlighted by standout performances like Blake Corum leading the Rams to a win over the Packers. College football rivalries and playoff resume rankings are also dominating sports discussions as the regular season reaches its climax.

global_summary: Today's news is dominated by holiday travel chaos caused by severe weather and airport incidents during the Thanksgiving weekend. Financial markets are reacting to rebounding tech stocks and shifting international trade pressures, while the entertainment world buzzes over massive entertainment launches like GTA VI and Black Friday shopping deals. Concurrently, a wide array of new scientific breakthroughs, space exploration updates, and packed sports schedules provide a diverse news landscape.
